title: Working for cash flow and years of financial aftermath
summary: It costs Herman more to work than not to, so he works for cash flow and talks daily to lawyers and tax people about problems that began long ago.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: No, you're working almost as often as you want to during the course of a year, now, aren't you?
Yes, but it's not really wise.
Yeah, yeah.
I do this for numerous reasons. Number one is, I can't exist without it.
All right.

Number two is to have a halfway decent sounding band, if we were doing it, we almost have to do it this way. But above all, it costs me more money to work than it does not to work, and that's the worst thing that can happen to you.
It does cost you more to work than not to?
Yes.
And so you are working for other purposes?
I'm working for cash flow.
Yeah, I understand.
Nothing more, nothing less.
Uh-huh.
But as far as ever making both ends meet, you never really come close.
I see.
That's why I'm on the phone to lawyers, to tax people, every day of my life.
Yeah, I noticed today during our interview, you are talking to a great variety of people, and I'm sitting here thinking, 'Man, he's still running all those empires out there, to keep this one going.'
Yeah.
And you --
I'm sure not everyone's problems could possibly be this weird, but because of my financial connections and what happened a long time ago, this is all aftermath, which has never really stopped.
I see. Is it getting close to being reconciled?
No.
At all?
No.
No?
I'll never live that long. That's when it gets heavy.
Oh, wow.
But also, you become pretty immune to a lot of things. If you have to.
I would think that if it were not for your deep and genuine enthusiasm, commitment, to the music, that this would have driven you off your gourd a long time ago.
Yeah, well, I'm a very stubborn, dumb Polack.
You're just persistent, resilient and all those other things.
Well, I do what I like to do, and I keep doing it because it's my only salvation.
